text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed tail latency spikes (10-50ms) in staging-3 when offload engages and host IO climbs. Feels like page-in stalls.
maya: Repro steps: run large-chat workload w/ batch=8, quantized model, then hammer embeddings concurrently.
cheng: Can you paste the dmesg / iostat snippet? suspect KV-cache thrash + nvme queue saturation.
maya: iostat showed util > 90% and avg await jumped. Attached small paste: `nvme0 95% util, avg_await 27ms`.
anuj: Two quick levers: 1) per-tenant page-throttle (limit concurrent page-ins) 2) adaptive prefetch budget (lower during high IO). Both avoid full allocator changes.
sarah: Prefer per-tenant soft-reservation rather than a global throttle. We want to protect high-SLO tenants from noisy neighbors.
kyle: Watch out for deadlock: if allocator holds metadata locks while waiting on page-in, throttling page-in could cause stall cascade. Need lock-free wait paths or handoff.
jon: Do we have telemetry for "page-in queue depth by tenant"? that's the minimal signal to drive backpressure.
infra-bot: alert: staging-3 nvme queue saturation spike at 1718765300 — correlated with large offload batches. :eyes:
cheng: Proposal: experiment A: add a cheap hysteresis controller in runtime that clamps offload page-in concurrency per-tenant when host_io_pct > 70%.
cheng: config trial (staging only):
```
offload.page_throttle_pct: 0.6
offload.prefetch_budget: 6
```
anuj: Also add a safety: if page-in latency > 50ms for >30s, automatically reduce prefetch to 2 and enable immediate fallback to smaller model variant for that tenant.
sarah: Agree. Also emit metrics: tenant_prefetch_budget, tenant_page_in_latency_ms_p95, host_nvme_util_pct. We'll need these on console to verify SLO impact.
kyle: I'll add a small change to allocator: do not hold allocation mutex across page-in path; convert to optimistic refcount + waiter queue to avoid the deadlock risk.
jon: Can we scope rollout: staging-3 -> staging-wide -> canary prod (5%)? Who owns the staging run?
cheng: I'll own the staging rollout and dashboard. Plan: 24h run, compare tail latency and cost. I'll open a dashboard and a small ingested eval set.
maya: Thanks — please add a short thread in RFCs if experiment shows promise. We should capture the tradeoffs (latency vs fragmentation vs cpu/io cost).
anuj: I'll draft a short RFC for the longer-term interface: expose per-tenant offload budget + a pluggable throttle policy (hysteresis, AIMD, leaky-bucket). Will link here when ready.
maya: SGTM. Action items: 1) cheng -> deploy throttle flags to staging-3 (now) 2) kyle -> allocator mutex refactor PR by EOD tomorrow 3) anuj -> RFC draft by Friday 4) sarah -> add SLO dashboards. :thumbsup:
jon: one more ask — capture failure modes (e.g., prefetch too low -> quality regressions) so Optimize can surface recommendations.
maya: noted. I'll add a quick prompt set to regression test prefetch changes.
